description: For jobsite safety, this completion sign-off form records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

blocks.guidance: Link this jobsite safety record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces for this jobsite safety.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces for this jobsite safety record.
sections.title: Walkthrough Reference

blocks.guidance: For jobsite safety, record pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every jobsite safety evidence source.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Evidence Sources

blocks.guidance: Explain each unnecessary jobsite safety evidence item.
items: Source, date, author, and version can be identified
Measurements include units and test conditions
Photos or attachments identify their location and purpose
Unknown or inaccessible conditions are conspicuous
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Evidence Completeness

blocks.guidance: Stop work for uncontrolled energy, fall exposure, excavation instability, missing protection, or imminent danger. Do not release affected jobsite safety work.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Stop and Review Boundary

blocks.guidance: Close jobsite safety exceptions with verification.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Exception and Corrective Action

blocks.guidance: Keep jobsite safety controls until authorized release.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Escalation Record

blocks.guidance: Transfer jobsite safety items to named owners.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Remaining Work and Handoff

sections.guidance: Compare jobsite safety findings with jobsite safety open items and decide the jobsite safety customer handoff.
sections.title: Walkthrough Finding and Correction Review

blocks.guidance: Match the jobsite safety outcome to evidence.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Final Outcome

fields.label: Jobsite Safety Acceptance Reservations and Care Notes

blocks.guidance: For jobsite safety, document competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger; identify each jobsite safety reservation and jobsite safety follow-up trigger, then record the jobsite safety instruction recipient.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Acceptance Reservations and Care Notes

sections.guidance: Close the jobsite safety record with competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
sections.title: Customer Acceptance and Handoff

subtitle: Jobsite Safety Completion Sign-Off Form: jobsite hazard assessment and control verification using work zone, task hazards, and pre-task briefing record.
title: Jobsite Safety Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
